votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve the ordinance changing the zone from OS and R-3 to PD-R on approximately 6.82 acres located at north of Gateway Drive, east of Cottonwood Springs Road, and west of the Twin Lakes Resort subdivision known as Twin Lakes, including the conditions approved by the Planning Commission: 1) The applicant will work with staff to address any concerns on drainage; 2) The applicant add ten (10) more guest parking stalls; and 3)The applicant dress up the backs and sides of the buildings. .
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
